wiki.title: Johnny Mautz
wiki.extract: John Frederick "Johnny" Mautz IV (born September 19, 1970) is an American politician who has served as a member of the Maryland Senate from District 37 since 2023. A member of the Republican Party, he previously represented District 37B in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023.
